chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ammar ibn Marwan, from Sama'ah ibn Mehran, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
Regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic,
"The bequest is for the parents and the near relatives, in a fair manner, a duty upon the Godwary."

He عليه السلام said: "It is something that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has assigned for the صاحب of this أمر." I said: "Is there a limit for that?" He said: "Yes." He said: I said: "And what is it?" He said: "The least that it may be is one-third of one-third."

key_terms.الْأَقْرَبِينَ: the close relatives referred to in the verse
key_terms.الْمُتَّقِينَ: those characterized by taqwa, upon whom this is stated as a duty
key_terms.الْوَالِدَيْنِ: the parents mentioned in the Qur'anic wording
key_terms.الْوَصِيَّةُ: the bequest or will being discussed in the verse
key_terms.بِالْمَعْرُوفِ: according to what is fair and recognized as proper
key_terms.ثُلُثُ الثُّلُثِ: one-third of one-third, the minimum amount mentioned
key_terms.حَدٌّ: a fixed limit or defined measure
key_terms.صَاحِبِ هَذَا الْأَمْرِ: the holder of this authority or matter, as described in the hadith

ai.seo_question: What does the verse about bequest to parents and relatives mean in this hadith from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic statement about bequest as referring to an entitlement designated by Allah for the صاحب of this الأمر. It also indicates a minimum quantified amount for that bequest, stated as one-third of one-third.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5562 - Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Muhammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ammar ibn Marwan from Sama'ah ibn Mehran from Abu Abdullah (as), regarding the saying of Allah (swt), the Almighty and Glorious: "The will is for the parents and close relatives in a fair manner; it is an obligation upon the righteous" (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:180).
Imam (as) said: "This is something that Allah (swt), the Almighty and Glorious, has designated for the one who holds this matter (referring to the rightful authority)."

I asked: "Is there a set limit for this?"
Imam (as) replied: "Yes."

I asked: "What is it?"
Imam (as) said: "The minimum is one-third of one-third."
